features.name: Barcode Scanning
features.description: Enable users to scan product barcodes using camera or external scanner to quickly identify and process inventory items
user_stories: As a store clerk, I want to scan a product barcode so that I can quickly look up product information
As a store manager, I want to scan multiple items rapidly so that I can perform stock counts efficiently
acceptance_criteria: System recognizes standard barcode formats (UPC, EAN-13, Code 128)
Scan completes within 2 seconds
System provides visual and audio feedback on successful scan
Invalid barcodes display appropriate error message

features.name: Real-time Inventory Tracking
features.description: Automatically update inventory levels as products are sold, received, or adjusted
user_stories: As a store owner, I want to see current stock levels in real-time so that I can make informed purchasing decisions
As a sales associate, I want inventory to update automatically after a sale so that stock counts remain accurate
acceptance_criteria: Inventory updates reflect within 1 second of transaction
System maintains transaction history for audit purposes
Low stock alerts trigger when inventory falls below threshold
Concurrent updates handled without data loss

features.name: Product Management
features.description: Add, edit, and remove products from the inventory database with detailed information
user_stories: As a store manager, I want to add new products with barcode, price, and description so that they can be tracked in inventory
As a store manager, I want to update product information so that pricing and details remain current
acceptance_criteria: All required product fields validated before saving
Duplicate barcodes prevented
Product images can be uploaded and displayed
Product categories can be assigned

features.name: Stock Adjustment
features.description: Manually adjust inventory quantities for corrections, damages, or discrepancies
user_stories: As a store manager, I want to adjust stock quantities manually so that I can correct counting errors
As a store manager, I want to record reasons for adjustments so that I can track shrinkage and damages
acceptance_criteria: Adjustment reason must be provided
All adjustments logged with timestamp and user
Adjustment history viewable per product
Negative adjustments cannot reduce stock below zero

features.name: Sales Transaction Processing
features.description: Process point-of-sale transactions and automatically update inventory
user_stories: As a cashier, I want to scan items and complete a sale so that customers can purchase products
As a cashier, I want to see the running total as I scan items so that I can inform the customer of their total
acceptance_criteria: Multiple items can be added to a single transaction
Transaction total calculated correctly including tax
Receipt generated upon completion
Inventory automatically decremented after sale

features.name: Inventory Reports
features.description: Generate reports on stock levels, sales trends, and inventory valuation
user_stories: As a store owner, I want to view inventory valuation reports so that I understand my investment in stock
As a store manager, I want to see which products are selling fastest so that I can optimize ordering
acceptance_criteria: Reports can be filtered by date range
Reports exportable to PDF and CSV
Low stock report shows items below reorder point
Sales velocity report shows units sold per time period

features.name: Supplier Management
features.description: Maintain supplier information and track purchase orders
user_stories: As a store manager, I want to store supplier contact information so that I can easily reorder products
As a store manager, I want to track which products come from which suppliers so that I can manage relationships
acceptance_criteria: Supplier contact details stored and editable
Products can be linked to suppliers
Purchase order history maintained
Supplier performance metrics available

features.name: User Authentication and Roles
features.description: Secure login system with role-based access control for different user types
user_stories: As a store owner, I want different permission levels so that employees only access appropriate functions
As a user, I want to log in securely so that my actions are tracked and the system is protected
acceptance_criteria: Users must authenticate before accessing system
Passwords encrypted and stored securely
Role-based permissions enforced (Admin, Manager, Clerk)
User activity logged for audit purposes

features.name: Low Stock Alerts
features.description: Automated notifications when inventory levels fall below defined thresholds
user_stories: As a store manager, I want to receive alerts when stock is low so that I can reorder before running out
As a store owner, I want to set custom reorder points per product so that alerts are relevant
acceptance_criteria: Reorder point configurable per product
Alerts displayed on dashboard
Email notifications sent to designated users
Alert dismissed only after stock replenished

features.name: Inventory Receiving
features.description: Process incoming shipments and update inventory quantities
user_stories: As a receiving clerk, I want to scan items as they arrive so that inventory is updated accurately
As a store manager, I want to match received items against purchase orders so that I can verify shipments
acceptance_criteria: Received items added to inventory immediately
Receiving transaction recorded with date and user
Discrepancies between expected and received quantities flagged
Batch receiving supported for efficiency

constraints: Must work on tablets and desktop computers
Must support both camera-based and USB barcode scanners
Must function with intermittent internet connectivity (offline mode)
Budget limited to small retail store operations (under $5000 initial investment)
Must handle at least 5 concurrent users
non_functional_requirements: Performance: System must respond to user actions within 1 second under normal load
Performance: Barcode scanning must complete within 2 seconds
Availability: System uptime of 99.5% during business hours
Scalability: Support up to 10,000 products and 100,000 transactions per year
Security: All passwords must be hashed using industry-standard algorithms
Security: Role-based access control must be enforced at all endpoints
Usability: New users should be able to perform basic operations within 30 minutes of training
Usability: Interface must be touch-friendly for tablet use
Reliability: Data must be backed up daily with point-in-time recovery capability
Compatibility: Must work on Windows 10+, macOS 10.14+, and modern web browsers
Maintainability: Code must follow established style guides with minimum 70% test coverage
Offline Capability: Core functions (scanning, sales) must work without internet connection
